generate_vim_syntax_core: generate Vim syntax rules for SPIR-V assembly files using a core SPIR-V grammar JSON file
generate_vim_syntax_glsl: generate Vim syntax rules for SPIR-V assembly with GLSL extended instruction set grammar
generate_vim_syntax_opencl: generate Vim syntax rules for SPIR-V assembly with OpenCL extended instruction set grammar
generate_vim_syntax_debuginfo: generate Vim syntax rules for SPIR-V assembly with DebugInfo extended instruction set grammar
generate_vim_syntax_all: generate Vim syntax rules for SPIR-V assembly with core and all extended instruction set grammars
